Stands in a current and lifts water 2 levels onto the bank behind it, with no workers. Lifts more in faster water (needs at least 0.15).
A worker walks the wheel and lifts water from the pit behind its left end to a ledge two rows behind its right end, about two levels up.
Collects a trickle of Water from the air with no workers: 1 every 4 hours in good weather, about a third of that in drought.
A worker pours stored Water into the basin or flume in front: 3 Water per hour becomes 0.6 cubic metres of clean water.
A mill driven by the current it stands in, with no shafts. Works faster in faster water.
Blocked: the tile ahead is solid. Water cannot leave this flume.
